system.description: You can have one cybernetic implant without getting a permanent Trauma. You start with the cybernetic Endocrine Synthesizer 'PEITHO', which grants Subtle Pheromones: advantage on rolls to charm or persuade non-hostile creatures.
system.gmNotes: Phase 07 should link the Endocrine Synthesizer 'PEITHO' implant from tnu-loot.
